thesis: The bear carries the immediate-purchase burden because dominant EPCC exposure and unknown project funding persist despite profitable quarterly execution. Neutral preserves the verified growth and backlog opportunity without paying for an assumed conversion outcome.
strongest_counterexample: Reported year-on-year revenue grew 13.2%, profit 19.8%, and net margin improved to 12.2%; the latest quarter already demonstrates profitable execution rather than only undelivered orders.
invalidation_conditions: A subsequent comparable disclosure reports positive CFO less project/capital investment and year-on-year profit growth above zero while documenting funding for backlog delivery, removing the principal conversion objection.
A disclosed net margin below the observed prior-year 11.5% alongside project cash outflow would invalidate the preserved improved-conversion scenario.
evidence_gaps: Debt, FCF and matched funding for EPCC delivery.
Sustainable project margins and cash timing.
Matched valuation; no externally verified solar-specific policy catalyst.
decisive_factors: Sequential revenue RM270.5m to RM155.9m demonstrates variability, not a verified delay.
RSI 82.0225 and 48.00x vendor reference do not validate immediate entry.
